name: TypeSafe AI
description: TypeSafe AI is a San Francisco AI lab building machine-native intelligence infrastructure for automation, designed to make decisions inside software rather than converse with people. Founded in 2024 by former OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida, a co-inventor of RLHF and InstructGPT, with Erik Gafni and Sasha Sheng, it emerged from two years in stealth in September 2026 with a $40 million seed round led by DCVC. Its first System One Model, Jev, returns typed probabilistic decisions with calibrated confidence in parallel at under 100 milliseconds, and the company claims order-of-magnitude speed and cost advantages over frontier LLMs for high-volume in-software decisions.

activity.title: Forbes framed Jev as a 'judgment model'
activity.description: A Forbes analysis argued that Jev shows the value of bounded judgment models that output probabilities rather than prose, citing its RLCD training and the Jevons-paradox naming.

activity.title: Vercel and Cloudflare integrations landed within days
activity.description: Forbes reported Jev pricing at $0.042 per million input tokens with free output tokens and sub-0.5-second latency, and that Vercel, Cloudflare, LangChain, and Langfuse integrations shipped within three days of launch.

activity.title: TechCrunch covered the launch and developer reaction
activity.description: TechCrunch reported that Jev is transformer-based but not an LLM, returning calibrated decisions rather than text, and noted a spike in API demand plus developer benchmarks from Vercel.

activity.title: InfoWorld examined the enterprise use case
activity.description: InfoWorld focused on using Jev for automated workflows such as tool choice, guardrails, and handoffs at 70 to 500 milliseconds, while noting caveats around upfront specification, calibration validation, and auditability.

activity.title: Jev went live on Vercel's AI Gateway
activity.description: A day after launch, Vercel listed Jev on its AI Gateway, and TechStartups recapped the stealth emergence, the $40 million DCVC-led round, and the 100x faster and cheaper claims.

activity.title: Emerged from stealth with $40M and launched Jev
activity.description: TypeSafe AI left two years of stealth with a $40 million seed round led by DCVC and early access to Jev, its first System One Model, alongside a technical post describing RLCD training and workflow evaluations showing 193.6x faster and 444.6x cheaper results.
